subject: Outstanding balance — legal & tax risk review
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Greenline Health <payments@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outstanding balance — INV-559 (past due)

Hi Maria / Greenline payments team,

Following up on invoice INV-559 for $112,400 (services through Feb 2027), which was due 2027-03-15 and remains unpaid. We've sent standard notices but haven't received confirmation of payment or a dispute.

To keep things moving and avoid further escalation, can you please:
- Confirm whether the invoice will be paid or formally disputed by COB Friday 2027-04-02
- If payment will be delayed for tax/VAT reasons, confirm the specific documentation you need from us (VAT reverse-charge, WHT forms, country-specific tax letters).

I've attached the invoice and our standard remittance instructions. If there's an internal process we should be aware of (PO hold, treasury cut-off), please share a contact so we can coordinate a short plan.

Attachments: Invoice_2027-03-INV559.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Maria Gonzales <maria.g@greenline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:12 -04:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance — INV-559 (past due)

Kimberly — thanks for the note.

We're currently holding payment on INV-559 pending resolution of VAT treatment. Our AP team has indicated this should be processed under a reverse-charge mechanism but we need:
1) Your company tax registration / VAT number and confirmation you are not charging VAT on the invoice
2) A short tax attestation (one-page) stating Redwood's applicability for reverse-charge for supplies to US-based customers (we'll share the exact wording our tax team needs)

If you can provide those documents, we can clear the hold and target payment mid-April. In the meantime, we can offer a partial release if Redwood is comfortable with a 25% prepayment to reduce operational disruption.

Attached is our internal note explaining the hold.

Maria Gonzales
VP, Finance — Greenline Health
maria.g@greenline.com

On Sun, Mar 28, 2027 at 09:12 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original invoice attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:40:25 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance — INV-559 (past due)

Kim — quick internal note.

Thanks for taking point. Greenline is strategic (expansion pilot in Q3) but this is creeping into a credit/collection risk. Two recommendations:
1) Offer the 25% prepayment to unblock production and signal good faith; require a firm payment date for the remainder tied to receipt of VAT paperwork.
2) Prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) that documents the split payment and confirms that the remainder is subject to VAT documentation, plus a fallback: if docs not received in 30 days, invoice moves back to collections and interest applies.

I'll handle the commercial ask and can join a 15-min exec call if legal or finance need to approve the wording. Sean / Hannah — if we approve 25% prepayment, please confirm we can release limited access and a temporary credit line while we secure documentation.

-Marissa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Greenline Health <payments@greenlinehealth.com>, Maria Gonzales <maria.g@greenline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 14:20:07 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance — INV-559 (past due)

Maria — thanks for the quick reply and for outlining the documentation needed. We can move forward with the compromise below if Greenline confirms in writing:

Proposed interim arrangement (short-term amendment):
- Greenline will remit 25% of INV-559 ($28,100) within 3 business days of signing the amendment.
- Redwood will mark the remaining 75% ($84,300) as "pending VAT documentation". No service interruption will occur during the 30-day documentation window.
- If required tax documentation is not received within 30 days, the outstanding balance will be subject to our standard collections policy (interest and potential suspension of service).

We have prepared a short collection plan and a DocuSign amendment to document the split payment and timelines. Link: docusign:0a1b2c3d
Attachments: collection_plan_Greenline_v2.xlsx; Invoice_2027-03-INV559.pdf

Please confirm acceptance and, if okay, someone from your AP team can sign the amendment so we can process the wire instructions.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gonzales <maria.g@greenline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Greenline Health <payments@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2027-04-01T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance — INV-559 (past due)

Kimberly / Team — we can agree to the 25% prepayment and will have our treasury cut the wire once the DocuSign amendment is returned. A few outstanding asks from our side:
- Please provide Redwood's VAT registration number and the one-page attestation noted above.
- We also need your SOC2 link and KYC (company registration) for our vendor onboarding.
- Update the invoice to clearly mark the remaining balance as subject to VAT reverse-charge and note the partial payment.

I have attached our internal mutation log for the AP ticket. Once we have the attestation and the updated invoice we'll sign the amendment and wire the 25%. Targeting payment by 2027-04-05.

Attachments: Greenline_Mutation_Log.csv

Regards,
Maria

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Greenline — collections status and next steps

Team — recap and asks:

Summary: Greenline agreed to a 25% prepayment pending our attestation + updated invoice. They target the wire on or about 2027-04-05. We have their mutation log and a HubSpot ticket (hubspot:1647382).

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize the DocuSign amendment and commercial language (I've attached the collection plan we sent).
- Sean: please confirm we can provide SOC2 link and company registration to Greenline; if SOC2 disclosure needs an NDA, flag to legal.
- Hannah: approve the temporary credit release and confirm whether we should mark the account as "at-risk" in the collections tracker.

If all greenlit, we'll send the attestation + updated invoice and then mark the account as "temporary credit" until the remainder is resolved. If anyone objects to the 25% compromise, let me know ASAP — otherwise I'll proceed.

Attachments: collection_plan_Greenline_v2.xlsx
Related: hubspot:1647382

Thanks — K
